documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approving Inter-Alia The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter Ended 30Th June 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Nitta Gelatin India Limited celebrated its Golden Jubilee in FY 2025-26, navigating global trade uncertainties and US tariff measures through market diversification. The company successfully commissioned its new Collagen Peptide Project with a capacity of 3.5 metric tonnes per day, while its Gelatin Expansion Project is progressing on schedule. Additionally, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision targeting a doubling of net sales and a 2.5 times increase in operating income by the fiscal year ending March 2033. Management remains optimistic about the gelatin industry's outlook, driven by growing demand in pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and food applications. Nitta Gelatin India Limited reported gross revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the gelatin industry also remains encouraging, supported by growing demand across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and specialty applications.

capex_expansion.claim: The ground-breaking ceremony for the Collagen Peptide expansion project took place on April 30, 2024, at Kakkanad, Kochi.
capex_expansion.quote: The Ground-Breaking ceremony (Bhumi Pooja) of your Company’s Collagen Peptide expansion project was held on April 30, 2024 at its factory located in Kakkanad, Kochi.

risks_headwinds.quote: The year was marked by heightened uncertainty in the global trade environment following tariff measures introduced by the United States, which impacted international supply chains and trade flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, volatility in global trade flows, and potential expansion of tariff measures by major economies warrant continued caution.
risks_headwinds.quote: Notwithstanding the positive domestic outlook, uncertainties arising from geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, volatility in global trade flows and the potential continuation or expansion of tariff measures by major economies, including the United States, warrant continued caution.
